data.narrative:
Nominal is a Series B-2 stage AI & Software company valued at $1B with $155M raised to date. The broader AI & Software sector contains 11 peer companies across public and private markets—1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. However, the peer set lacks sufficient depth at Nominal's specific stage and valuation tier to support a robust peer-median methodology.

Traditional peer-median valuation is not applicable here. A rigorous same-stage analysis yielded zero datapoints, and adjacent-stage filtering produced zero results. Similar-tier comparables generated only 2 datapoints—below the three-company minimum threshold required for statistical reliability in this approach. Expanding to an all-sector median would introduce significant noise given the heterogeneity across the 11 AI & Software comparables in terms of stage, revenue maturity, and business model.

Without sufficient narrow-set peer triangulation, this analysis cannot defensibly narrow Nominal's valuation range beyond its stated $1B mark. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or growth metrics in the provided data, the nascency of comparable company multiples at the Series B-2 stage in AI, and limited visibility into the capital efficiency and unit economics of identified peers. A more granular valuation would require either expansion of the peer set or application of alternative methods (discounted cash flow, revenue multiples) using proprietary financial data on Nominal and its comparables.
